SELECT * FROM accountbalances LIMIT 3;

SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot, r.ordervault, o.userlink 
FROM riskandmargin r 
JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault 
LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot, 
       r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' as possum,
       r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' as posmagn,
       ab.walletsum
FROM riskandmargin r
JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
JOIN accountbalances ab ON u.userstamp = ab.usertag
LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot AS risk_margin_record_id,
       CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS numeric) AS position_value,
       CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS numeric) AS position_leverage_multiplier,
       ab.walletsum AS account_balance,
       ROUND(CAST((CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS numeric) * CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS numeric)) / ab.walletsum AS numeric), 4) AS leverage_ratio
FROM riskandmargin r
JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
JOIN accountbalances ab ON u.userstamp = ab.usertag
LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot AS risk_margin_record_id,
       CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS numeric) AS position_value,
       CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS numeric) AS position_leverage_multiplier,
       ab.walletsum AS account_balance,
       ROUND(CAST((CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS numeric) * CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS numeric)) / ab.walletsum AS numeric), 4) AS leverage_ratio,
       ROUND(CAST((CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'margin_thresholds'->>'inithold' AS numeric) / ab.margsum) * 100 AS numeric), 4) AS margin_utilization,
       CASE WHEN (CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS numeric) * CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS numeric)) / ab.walletsum > 20
